registers.name: i2s_version
registers.description: I2S controller version register. Reports the major and minor release numbers of this IP.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version number of the I2S controller. A change of this number marks an incompatible register or behavior change.

Usage: Read once after reset so the driver can select the matching programming model; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0001 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version number of the I2S controller. A change of this number marks a compatible addition.

Usage: Read once after reset for diagnostics; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0000 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

registers.name: i2s_ier
registers.description: I2S enable register. Globally enables the controller and selects the interface type, the TDM frame format and the operating mode.

fields.name: ien
fields.description:
I2S global enable. While it is 0 the whole controller is held idle: both FIFO banks are emptied, in-flight serial data is dropped and every block, channel and slot enable is overridden.

Usage: Set after the other registers are programmed; clear to stop everything. The fields intf_type, frame_off, tdm_slots and i2s_op_mode must be written only while this bit is 0.

Values:
0x0 controller disabled (reset value);
0x1 controller enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: intf_type
fields.description:
Audio interface type. Selects between the standard two-slot I2S frame and the multi-slot TDM frame on the single serial data line.

Usage: Write while ien is 0. The bit is writable only when the configuration supports both interfaces; in a TDM-only build it reads 1 and ignores writes, in a build without TDM it reads 0.

Values:
0x0 standard I2S interface (reset value in an I2S build);
0x1 TDM interface.

Unit: none.

Limits: effective only when PARA_I2S_HAS_TDM is 1.

fields.name: frame_off
fields.description:
TDM frame offset. Chooses whether slot data starts at the word-select pulse itself or one serial-clock cycle after it.

Usage: Write while ien is 0 and only in TDM mode. It also moves the sclk_gate timing of the first slot in controller mode.

Values:
0x0 data aligned with the word-select pulse, 0 sclk delay (reset value);
0x1 data starts 1 sclk cycle after the pulse.

Unit: sclk cycles.

Limits: effective only in TDM mode.

fields.name: tdm_slots
fields.description:
Number of TDM slots minus one. Sets how many 32-bit slots form one TDM frame for both the transmitter and the receiver.

Usage: Write while ien is 0. A value above the configured maximum slot count minus one is replaced by that maximum.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF frame has value plus one slots; reset value is the maximum slot count of the delivered configuration minus one, 0x3.

Unit: slots minus one.

Limits: at most PARA_I2S_TDM_SLOTS minus one; effective only in TDM mode.

fields.name: i2s_op_mode
fields.description:
Operating mode. Selects whether the controller generates the serial clock gating and word select as a controller or follows external signals as a target.

Usage: Write while ien is 0. The bit is writable only when programmable controller/target mode is configured.

Values:
0x0 target mode (reset value);
0x1 controller mode.

Unit: none.

Limits: writable only when PARA_I2S_MODE_EN is 2.

registers.name: i2s_irer
registers.description: I2S receiver block enable register. Enables or disables every receive channel together.

fields.name: rxen
fields.description:
Receiver block enable. A 0 overrides every individual receive channel enable and discards incoming data while the RX FIFOs keep their content.

Usage: Set after the receive channels are programmed. When set, reception resumes at the next left-channel cycle. In TDM mode the single receive channel is always on and this bit is the only control.

Values:
0x0 receiver block disabled (reset value);
0x1 receiver block enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_iter
registers.description: I2S transmitter block enable register. Enables or disables every transmit channel together.

fields.name: txen
fields.description:
Transmitter block enable. A 0 overrides every individual transmit channel enable, drops outgoing data and holds the serial data outputs low while the TX FIFOs keep their content.

Usage: Set after the TX FIFOs are filled. When set, transmission resumes at the next left-channel cycle. In TDM mode the single transmit channel is always on and this bit is the only control.

Values:
0x0 transmitter block disabled (reset value);
0x1 transmitter block enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_cer
registers.description: I2S clock enable register. Starts and stops the controller-mode clock generation block.

fields.name: clken
fields.description:
Clock generation enable. Enables the controller-mode outputs ws_out, sclk_en and sclk_gate. When 0, ws_out is held low and any serial data in flight is lost while FIFO content is preserved.

Usage: Set last, after the channels and the i2s_ccr fields are programmed. After enabling, ws_out starts in the left cycle. Meaningful only in controller mode.

Values:
0x0 clock generation disabled (reset value);
0x1 clock generation enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: present only when PARA_I2S_MODE_EN is not 0.

registers.name: i2s_ccr
registers.description: I2S clock configuration register. Sets the word select length and the serial clock gating of the controller mode.

fields.name: wss
sclkg

registers.name: i2s_rxffr
registers.description: I2S receiver block FIFO reset register. Flushes all receive FIFOs at once.

fields.name: rxffr
fields.description:
Receiver FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties every RX FIFO and resets its pointers; the bit clears itself when the flush is done and always reads as 0.

Usage: Disable the receiver block (i2s_irer.rxen = 0) before writing 1; writing while it is enabled is not supported.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush all RX FIFOs.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_txffr
registers.description: I2S transmitter block FIFO reset register. Flushes all transmit FIFOs at once.

fields.name: txffr
fields.description:
Transmitter FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties every TX FIFO and resets its pointers; the bit clears itself when the flush is done and always reads as 0.

Usage: Disable the transmitter block (i2s_iter.txen = 0) before writing 1; writing while it is enabled is not supported.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush all TX FIFOs.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_sr
registers.description: I2S status register. Reports whether the transmit FIFOs are completely empty.

fields.name: tfe
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO empty. Set when the transmit FIFOs of all enabled channels or slots hold no data; cleared as soon as any of them holds an entry. It does not raise an interrupt.

Usage: Poll it before disabling the interface at the end of a stream. The last frame is popped together with its right sample or last slot, so wait one word-select length or one 32-clock slot after it sets.

Values:
0x0 at least one TX FIFO holds data;
0x1 all TX FIFOs are empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: present only when the transmitter block is configured with TDM.

registers.name: i2s_lrbr
registers.description: Left receive buffer register. Returns the left audio sample at the head of the RX FIFO of one channel.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Left received audio sample of the channel selected by the register index. The sample was shifted in on the sd line while ws was low.

Usage: Read after the data-available interrupt, always followed by one read of i2s_rrbr of the same channel to keep the pair in step; a read pops the left FIFO bank.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF left sample taken from the left RX FIFO bank; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rrbr
registers.description: Right receive buffer register. Returns the right audio sample at the head of the RX FIFO of one channel.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Right received audio sample of the channel selected by the register index. The sample was shifted in on the sd line while ws was high.

Usage: Read only after the matching i2s_lrbr read; a read pops the right FIFO bank.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF right sample taken from the right RX FIFO bank; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rer
registers.description: Receive enable register. Enables one receive channel, or the slots of the TDM frame.

fields.name: rxslot15_en

Usage: Program before enabling the receiver block. A disabled slot is skipped: no FIFO push for it.

0x0 slot 15 disabled;
0x1 slot 15 enabled (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: effective only in TDM mode and only for slots below the configured slot count.

registers.name: i2s_isr
registers.description: Interrupt status register. Shows the current, unmasked-independent state of the receive and transmit interrupt causes of one channel.

fields.name: rxda
fields.description:
RX data available status. High while the RX FIFO fill level has reached the trigger level programmed in i2s_rfcr.rxchdt.

Usage: Poll it or use it as interrupt cause; it falls when the FIFO is read below the trigger level. It shows the state whether or not the interrupt is masked.

Values:
0x0 trigger level not reached (reset value);
0x1 trigger level reached.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rxfo
fields.description:
RX overrun status. High after received data was dropped because the RX FIFO was full.

Usage: Cleared by reading i2s_ror of the same channel.

Values:
0x0 no overrun (reset value);
0x1 RX FIFO overrun occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txfe
fields.description:
TX FIFO empty status. High while the TX FIFO fill level is at or below the trigger level in i2s_tfcr.txchet.

Usage: It falls when software writes data above the trigger level. Shows the state whether or not the interrupt is masked.

Values:
0x0 trigger level not reached;
0x1 TX FIFO at or below trigger level (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txfo
fields.description:
TX overrun status. High after a write to a full TX FIFO was dropped.

Usage: Cleared by reading i2s_ticr of the same channel.

Values:
0x0 no overrun (reset value);
0x1 TX FIFO overrun occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txfu
fields.description:
TX underrun status. High after a frame started while the TX FIFO was empty and zeros were sent instead of data.

Usage: Cleared by reading i2s_ticr of the same channel.

Values:
0x0 no underrun (reset value);
0x1 TX FIFO underrun occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_imr

registers.name: i2s_ror
registers.description: Receive overrun register. Reading it reports and clears the RX FIFO overrun of one channel.

fields.name: rxcho
fields.description:
Receive channel overrun. Set by hardware when received data is lost because the RX FIFO is full; the read returns the value and then clears it, which also clears the interrupt.

Usage: Read it in the overrun interrupt service routine. Reading while no overrun is pending returns 0.

Values:
0x0 no overrun (reset value);
0x1 an overrun occurred since the last read.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_ticr
registers.description: Transmit interrupt clear register. Reading it reports and clears the TX overrun and underrun of one channel.

fields.name: txchou
fields.description:
Transmit channel overrun or underrun. Set by hardware when a write hit a full TX FIFO or a frame started with an empty FIFO; the read returns the value and then clears it and both interrupt causes.

Usage: Read it in the TX error interrupt service routine; i2s_isr tells which cause occurred before the read.

Values:
0x0 no overrun or underrun (reset value);
0x1 overrun or underrun occurred since the last read.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_rfcr
registers.description: Receive FIFO configuration register. Sets the data-available trigger level of one RX FIFO.

fields.name: rxchdt
fields.description:
Receive channel data trigger. Trigger level minus one at which the RX FIFO raises the data-available interrupt and the DMA request.

Usage: Write only while the channel (or, in TDM mode, the receiver block) is disabled. A value above the last legal one saturates to FIFO depth minus one.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF trigger level equals value plus one entries; reset value 0x03 gives 4 entries.

Unit: FIFO entries minus one.

Limits: 0 to FIFO depth minus one; the field is 4 bits wide when the depth is 16 or less.

registers.name: i2s_tfcr
registers.description: Transmit FIFO configuration register. Sets the empty trigger level of one TX FIFO.

fields.name: txchet
fields.description:
Transmit channel empty trigger. Fill level at or below which the TX FIFO raises the empty interrupt and the DMA request.

Usage: Write only while the channel (or, in TDM mode, the transmitter block) is disabled. A value above the last legal one saturates to FIFO depth minus one.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF trigger level equals the value in entries; reset value 0x03.

Unit: FIFO entries.

Limits: 0 to FIFO depth minus one; the field is 4 bits wide when the depth is 16 or less.

registers.name: i2s_rff
registers.description: Receive FIFO flush register. Flushes the RX FIFO of one channel.

fields.name: rxchfr
fields.description:
Receive channel FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties the RX FIFO of the selected channel (all slot FIFOs in TDM mode); the bit clears itself and reads as 0.

Usage: Disable the channel or the receiver block first. Use it to resynchronize a left/right pair that got out of step.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush the RX FIFO.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_tff
registers.description: Transmit FIFO flush register. Flushes the TX FIFO of one channel.

fields.name: txchfr
fields.description:
Transmit channel FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties the TX FIFO of the selected channel (all slot FIFOs in TDM mode); the bit clears itself and reads as 0.

Usage: Disable the channel or the transmitter block first. Use it to resynchronize a left/right pair that got out of step.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush the TX FIFO.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: i2s_lthr
registers.description: Left transmit holding register. Accepts the left audio sample of a stereo pair for one transmit channel.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Left audio sample to transmit on the channel selected by the register index. It is read back as 0.

Usage: Write the left sample first and the right sample to i2s_rthr second; write only while the FIFO is not full, because a write to a full FIFO is lost and flags an overrun.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF left sample pushed to the left TX FIFO bank; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rthr
registers.description: Right transmit holding register. Accepts the right audio sample of a stereo pair for one transmit channel.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Right audio sample to transmit on the channel selected by the register index. It is read back as 0.

Usage: Write only after the matching i2s_lthr write; a write to a full FIFO is lost and flags an overrun.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF right sample pushed to the right TX FIFO bank; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rxdma
registers.description: Receiver block DMA register. Cyclic read port that returns the next sample of the enabled receive channels or slots.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Receiver block DMA data. Each read returns the left, then the right sample of the lowest enabled channel, then of the next enabled channel and so on; in TDM mode each read returns one enabled slot.

Usage: Read it instead of i2s_lrbr and i2s_rrbr when combined DMA handshake is used. Do not disable a channel between the left and right read of a pair.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF next sample in the cyclic channel order; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rrxdma
registers.description: Reset receiver block DMA register. Rewinds the cyclic read pointer of i2s_rxdma to the lowest enabled channel or slot.

fields.name: rrxdma
fields.description:
Reset receiver DMA pointer. Writing 1 moves the cyclic read pointer back to the lowest enabled channel or slot; it clears itself and reads as 0.

Usage: Use it to resynchronize after an error. It has no effect between the left and the right read of a stereo pair.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 reset the pointer.

Unit: none.

Limits: present only with more than one channel or slot.

registers.name: i2s_txdma
registers.description: Transmitter block DMA register. Cyclic write port that stores the next sample of the enabled transmit channels or slots.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Transmitter block DMA data. Each write stores the left, then the right sample of the lowest enabled channel, then of the next enabled channel and so on; in TDM mode each write stores one enabled slot.

Usage: Write it instead of i2s_lthr and i2s_rthr when combined DMA handshake is used. Do not disable a channel between the left and right write of a pair.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF next sample in the cyclic channel order; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rtxdma
registers.description: Reset transmitter block DMA register. Rewinds the cyclic write pointer of i2s_txdma to the lowest enabled channel or slot.

fields.name: rtxdma
fields.description:
Reset transmitter DMA pointer. Writing 1 moves the cyclic write pointer back to the lowest enabled channel or slot; it clears itself and reads as 0.

Usage: Use it to resynchronize after an error. It has no effect between the left and the right write of a stereo pair.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 reset the pointer.

Unit: none.

Limits: present only with more than one channel or slot.

registers.name: i2s_cparam2
registers.description: Component parameter register 2. Reports the maximum receive audio resolution of each channel.

fields.name: rx_wsize_3
fields.description:
Receive channel 3 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: rx_wsize_2
fields.description:
Receive channel 2 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: rx_wsize_1
fields.description:
Receive channel 1 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: rx_wsize_0
fields.description:
Receive channel 0 and TDM slots maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

registers.name: i2s_cparam1
registers.description: Component parameter register 1. Reports the build configuration of the controller.

fields.name: op_mode_en
fields.description:
Programmable mode support. Reports the build option for the controller/target role.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn whether i2s_ier.i2s_op_mode is writable.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3 the value of PARA_I2S_MODE_EN; reset value 0x0 means target only.

Unit: none.

Limits: present only when PARA_I2S_MODE_EN is 2.

fields.name: tx_wsize_3
fields.description:
Transmit channel 3 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: tx_wsize_2
fields.description:
Transmit channel 2 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: tx_wsize_1
fields.description:
Transmit channel 1 maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: tx_wsize_0
fields.description:
Transmit channel 0 and TDM slots maximum audio resolution encoding. Reports the configured maximum audio word length of that channel.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn the build configuration; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 12, 16, 20, 24 or 32 bit; reset value is the delivered default configuration, 0x1.

Unit: encoded bit width.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: fdepth_hi
fields.description:
FIFO depth encoding for large depths. Reports the FIFO depth of all channels when it is larger than 16 entries.

Usage: Read together with fdepth_lo to learn the FIFO depth.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 or 256 entries; reset value 0x0 because the default depth is 8.

Unit: encoded depth.

Limits: valid only when the depth is above 16.

fields.name: tx_chs
fields.description:
Transmit channel count minus one. Reports the number of configured transmit channels.

Usage: Read by the driver to size its channel loops.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3 1 to 4 transmit channels; reset value 0x0 is one channel.

Unit: channels minus one.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: rx_chs
fields.description:
Receive channel count minus one. Reports the number of configured receive channels.

Usage: Read by the driver to size its channel loops.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3 1 to 4 receive channels; reset value 0x0 is one channel.

Unit: channels minus one.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: rx_blk
fields.description:
Receiver block present. Reports whether the receiver block is built.

Usage: Read by the driver before using receive registers.

Values:
0x0 receiver block absent;
0x1 receiver block present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: tx_blk
fields.description:
Transmitter block present. Reports whether the transmitter block is built.

Usage: Read by the driver before using transmit registers.

Values:
0x0 transmitter block absent;
0x1 transmitter block present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the build parameter.

fields.name: mode_en
fields.description:
Controller mode build option. Reports whether the fixed controller mode is built.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn whether the clock generation registers exist.

Values:
0x0 target (reset value);
0x1 controller.

Unit: none.

Limits: present only when PARA_I2S_MODE_EN is 0 or 1.

fields.name: fdepth_lo
apb_width
fields.description:
APB data width encoding. Reports the configured APB data width of the build.

Usage: Read by the driver to learn how many bus accesses a register needs.

Values:
0x0 8 bit;
0x1 16 bit;
0x2 32 bit (reset value).

Unit: bits.

Limits: this specification supports only 32 bit.

registers.name: i2s_comp_ver
registers.description: Component version register. Reports the vendor-compatible component version code.

fields.name: comp_ver
fields.description:
Component version code. A fixed code that lets existing drivers recognize the component release; it is separate from i2s_version.

Usage: Read by a driver that checks the code.

Values:
0x3131342A ASCII code of the component release 1.14a (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

registers.name: i2s_comp_type
registers.description: Component type register. Reports the fixed component type identifier.

fields.name: comp_type
fields.description:
Component type identifier. A fixed code made of the two ASCII letters DW followed by a 16-bit number; existing drivers read it to recognize the I2S component.

Usage: Read by a driver that checks the identifier.

Values:
0x445701A0 I2S component type (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

registers.name: i2s_dmacr
registers.description: DMA control register. Enables the DMA handshake of each receive or transmit channel or block.

fields.name: dmaen_txblock
fields.description:
DMA enable for the transmitter block. Enables the dma_tx handshake of the combined interface for all transmit channels or slots.

Usage: Write after the matching block or channel is enabled and the FIFO trigger levels are programmed. The bit is effective only with the DMA handshake interface built.

Values:
0x0 DMA handshake disabled (reset value);
0x1 DMA handshake enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: combined DMA handshake build only.

fields.name: dmaen_rxblock
fields.description:
DMA enable for the receiver block. Enables the dma_rx handshake of the combined interface for all receive channels or slots.

Usage: Write after the matching block or channel is enabled and the FIFO trigger levels are programmed. The bit is effective only with the DMA handshake interface built.

Values:
0x0 DMA handshake disabled (reset value);
0x1 DMA handshake enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: combined DMA handshake build only.

fields.name: dmaen_txch_3
fields.description:

Usage: Write after the matching block or channel is enabled and the FIFO trigger levels are programmed. The bit is effective only with the DMA handshake interface built.

Values:
0x0 DMA handshake disabled (reset value);
0x1 DMA handshake enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: dedicated DMA handshake build and channel 3 present.

registers.name: i2s_rxdma_ch
registers.description: Receive channel DMA register. Read port of one receive channel for a dedicated DMA handshake.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Receive channel DMA data. Each read returns the next left or right sample of the channel selected by the register index.

Usage: Read by the DMA controller after dma_rx_req_x; with the dedicated handshake the cyclic i2s_rxdma register is not used.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF next sample of the channel in left, right order; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_txdma_ch
registers.description: Transmit channel DMA register. Write port of one transmit channel for a dedicated DMA handshake.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Transmit channel DMA data. Each write stores the next left or right sample of the channel selected by the register index.

Usage: Written by the DMA controller after dma_tx_req_x; with the dedicated handshake the cyclic i2s_txdma register is not used.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF next sample of the channel in left, right order; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_rslot
registers.description: Receive slot register. Read port of one received TDM slot.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Receive slot data. Returns the oldest received sample of the slot selected by the register index.

Usage: Read after the data-available interrupt. A read pops the slot FIFO; reads of a slot that is disabled return 0.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF slot sample taken from the slot RX FIFO; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.

registers.name: i2s_tslot
registers.description: Transmit slot register. Write port of one TDM slot.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Transmit slot data. Stores the sample sent in the slot selected by the register index in the next frame.

Usage: Write only while the slot FIFO is not full; a write to a full FIFO is lost and flags an overrun.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF slot sample pushed to the slot TX FIFO; unused upper bits read as 0.

Unit: audio sample, LSB aligned.

Limits: valid width is the programmed word length of the channel, at most 32 bits.
